{
  "title": "SHG Loan Repayment & Purpose Report",
  "subtitle": "Analysis of loan repayment status and purpose distribution across blocks",
  "panels": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Loans Disbursed",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM \"shg_loan_register\"",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Overdue Loans",
      "sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM \"shg_loan_register\" WHERE \"Repayment Status\" = 'Overdue'",
      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Total Amount Repaid",
      "sql": "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(\"Amount Repaid (Rs)\"), 0) AS n FROM \"shg_loan_register\"",
      "unit": "Rs"
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Repayment Rate",
      "sql": "SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN \"Repayment Status\" = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0), 1) AS n FROM \"shg_loan_register\"",
      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Loans by Purpose",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Purpose\" AS purpose, COUNT(*) AS count FROM \"shg_loan_register\" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC",

      "y": ["count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Repayment Status by Block",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Block\" AS block, \"Repayment Status\" AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM \"shg_loan_register\" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2",
      "x": "block",
      "y": ["count"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p7",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "Loan Details by Purpose",
      "sql": "SELECT \"Purpose\", \"Repayment Status\", COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(\"Loan Amount (Rs)\") AS total_disbursed, SUM(\"Amount Repaid (Rs)\") AS total_repaid FROM \"shg_loan_register\" GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "The SHG loan program has disbursed {{p1}} loans in total. Among these, {{p2}} loans are currently marked as Overdue, while the overall repayment rate stands at {{p4}}. The total amount repaid so far is {{p3}}. Looking at the distribution of loan purposes, the bar chart shows the volume of loans taken for each category. The table below provides a detailed breakdown of loan counts and amounts by purpose and repayment status, allowing for a granular view of financial health across different sectors."
}

      "unit": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Literacy Rate",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(\"Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)\") AS avg_literacy FROM \"district_health_factsheet\" WHERE \"District\" != 'State Total'",
      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p3",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Vaccination Rate",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(\"Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)\") AS avg_vaccination FROM \"district_health_factsheet\" WHERE \"District\" != 'State Total'",
      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p4",
      "kind": "kpi",
      "title": "Avg Institutional Births",
      "sql": "SELECT AVG(\"Institutional births (%)\") AS avg_institutional FROM \"district_health_factsheet\" WHERE \"District\" != 'State Total'",
      "unit": "%"
    },
    {
      "id": "p5",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Vaccination Rate by District",
      "sql": "SELECT \"District\", AVG(\"Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)\") AS avg_vaccination FROM \"district_health_factsheet\" WHERE \"District\" != 'State Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15",
      "x": "District",
      "y": ["avg_vaccination"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p6",
      "kind": "bar",
      "title": "Stunting Prevalence by District",
      "sql": "SELECT \"District\", AVG(\"Children under 5 years who are stunted (%)\") AS avg_stunting FROM \"district_health_factsheet\" WHERE \"District\" != 'State Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15",
      "x": "District",
      "y": ["avg_stunting"]
    },
    {
      "id": "p7",
      "kind": "table",
      "title": "District Health Summary",
      "sql": "SELECT \"District\", ROUND(AVG(\"Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)\"), 1) AS avg_literacy, ROUND(AVG(\"Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)\"), 1) AS avg_vaccination, ROUND(AVG(\"Institutional births (%)\"), 1) AS avg_births, ROUND(AVG(\"Children under 5 years who are stunted (%)\"), 1) AS avg_stunting FROM \"district_health_factsheet\" WHERE \"District\" != 'State Total' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY avg_vaccination DESC"
    }
  ],
  "narrative": "This dashboard provides a comparative view of health outcomes across {{p1}} districts. The average literacy rate among women aged 15-49 is {{p2}}, indicating the baseline for health awareness in the region. Vaccination coverage for children aged 12-23 months stands at {{p3}} on average, while institutional births account for {{p4}} of all deliveries. The bar charts highlight significant variations in vaccination and stunting rates between districts, with the highest vaccination rates shown in the top performing areas.
